name: She no longer comes to the surface.
source:
You look at your hideous reflection on the lake — she no longer comes to the surface.

[From [url=https://cute-the-niini.itch.io/she-no-longer-comes-to-the-surface]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你看着湖面上自己丑陋的倒影——她不再浮出水面。

[来自[url=https://cute-the-niini.itch.io/she-no-longer-comes-to-the-surface]itch.io[/url]]
